_meta.purpose: Default heat-demand parameters for the pre-step estimator. Applies before suissetec's full Verbrauchsmethode kicks in.
_meta.scope: Single-family homes (EFH) and small multi-family (MFH) in St. Gallen. Adjust factors for other building types.
_meta.needsAnchoring: Build-era kWh/m²·yr defaults and component U-values are working values consistent with BFE building stock data and MuKEn 2014 / SIA 380/1. They should be cross-checked against canonical sources before the v1 ships to customers — not yet done.

domesticHotWater.note: SIA 380/1 typical. Range 700–900 depending on usage profile.

envelopeLossShares._note: Approximate share of total transmission+ventilation loss for a typical EFH. Sums to 1.0.

renovationImpact._note: Multiplier applied to a component's loss share when renovated in the given decade. 1.0 = no improvement, 0.0 = perfect. Values are approximations of U-value reductions vs the building's original era.

buildingTypeFactor._note: Adjusts heat demand for envelope/floor-area ratio. EFH = 1.0 baseline.

ruleOfThumbWPerM2._note: Specific heating power (W/m²) used for sanity-checking pump sizing. Heat load ≈ W/m² × heated area.
